dataset.name: Sap flow and Dendrometer Metadata from 10-2015 to 06-2016 at the Puerto Rico TRACE Site
description: This data package contains metadata relevant to the sapflow and dendrometer dataset, "Sap flow and Dendrometer Raw Data from 10-2015 to 06-2016 at the Forest Service TRACE project in Sabana, PR." Reference files include a schematic map of the plot, sensor manuals, and a journal article describing sap flow processing procedures. Included in the attached zip file is an Excel file "E-Field_Log_v1_PR-Sab_20160707.xlsx," which is a part of the FRAMES templates used for file level metadata reporting and includes site details, sensor installation dates, species information, and more. For additional details on the use of FRAMES metadata reporting templates, see the data package "Danielle Christianson et al. (2018) FRAMES Metadata Reporting Templates for Ecohydrological Observations, version 1.1. NGEE Tropics Data Collection. Accessed at http://dx.doi.org/10.15486/ngt/1419956." Also included in this data package are sensor manuals, a schematic map of the plot, and a journal article describing sap flow processing procedures.
This dataset was originally published on the NGEE Tropics Archive and is being mirrored on ESS-DIVE for long-term archival

spatialCoverage.description: Site Name: Sabana. Site ID: PR-Sab. Located in Puerto Rico. The Sabana Field Research Station is in the Rio Sabana watershed, contains a monitoring station on the Rio Sabana, and is a short drive from the Bisley Long-term Ecological Research watersheds. (CZO website). The TRACE experiment (http://forestwarming.org) is located at Sabana. For more information on this site, visit: http://criticalzone.org/luquillo/infrastructure/field-area/sabana-field-station1/#settingResearch Site contact(s): (Grizelle González <ggonzalez@fs.fed.us>)
